items.s: Our own signature design on every screen: indigo and dawn colours (no beige or brown), a salah card whose sky changes with the next salah, the straight path line through Home, Dhikr and the surah list, the Qur'an page with your khatmah as 30 juz steps, tap chips for notifications, and a calendar that shows your salah under each day.

Our own look, not a copy: a light 'Next salah' card with one big Mark button, and 'Today's path' with your salah and timed tasks on one line and a red Now marker. The date stays on one line, and the tab bar no longer covers anything.
Tap a salah: On time / Made up / Excused, then one drop-down with Ayat al-Kursi, Tasbih 33·33·34 and Adhkar, each with its source.
Low = quick tasks first, High = big tasks first. Each task shows its size.
Continue reading, all surahs with search, listen, my khatmah
